name: San Leandro
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in San Leandro, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in San Leandro, CA: the downtown tree lighting, Santa at the fire house, cookies with the police and a library marionette show.
lede: San Leandro keeps its Christmas close to downtown: a tree lighting with free Santa photos and train rides, Santa at a fire station, cookies at the police department and a marionette show at the main library.
celebrates: The season centers on It's a Wonderful Night, the Downtown San Leandro Community Benefit District's evening of tree lighting, Santa, holiday train rides and a market on West Juana Avenue. City departments add their own events. The Alameda County Fire Department brings Santa to Fire Station 9, the San Leandro Police Department serves holiday cookies while it collects toys for local children, and the San Leandro Public Library plans a marionette show, a singalong and a gingerbread playdate.
lastyear: In 2025 It's a Wonderful Night ran on Friday, December 5, with the downtown tree lighting at Estudillo Plaza, holiday performances, Santa photos, train rides and a market. The Tri-City Voice covered it in its round-up of East Bay tree lightings that week.
facts: It's a Wonderful Night reaches its 29th year in 2026, so downtown San Leandro has lit its holiday tree with this celebration since the late 1990s. The tree stands in Estudillo Plaza, at Estudillo Avenue and East 14th Street, in the middle of the old downtown. San Leandro's best-known festival is in summer, not winter: the San Leandro Historical Society notes that the first Cherry Festival was held in 1909.
trains: San Leandro has two BART stations, San Leandro and Bay Fair. Bay Fair station, at 15242 Hesperian Boulevard, serves Bayfair Center, according to BART. On the night of It's a Wonderful Night, the train for kids is the small holiday train that gives rides around the downtown event on West Juana Avenue.
train_links: Steam and diesel trains through Niles Canyon from Sunol and Niles, home of the Train of Lights.
The Tilden Park steam trains in Berkeley, on 1.25 miles of track through the redwoods.
Historic interurban cars and an 11-mile ride in Suisun City.
traditions: Downtown San Leandro lights its tree at Estudillo Plaza and fills West Juana Avenue with Santa, train rides and a holiday market.
The Alameda County Fire Department hosts free photos with Santa at Fire Station 9 and collects toys.
The police department serves sweet treats and asks guests to bring a new, unwrapped toy for children in need.
Holiday programs at the Main Library
The San Leandro Public Library hosts a marionette show, a seasonal singalong and a gingerbread playdate.
kidfact: Downtown San Leandro has lit a holiday tree at It's a Wonderful Night for 29 years, and Santa poses for free photos there every time.
faq: When is the San Leandro tree lighting in 2026?

The tree lighting is at 5:30 pm on Friday, December 4, 2026, at Estudillo Plaza, Estudillo Avenue at East 14th Street. It opens It's a Wonderful Night, which runs from 5 to 9 pm, with the main event on West Juana Avenue around Butterfly Plaza.
Where can kids see Santa in San Leandro?
Santa poses for free photos at It's a Wonderful Night on December 4 and at Santa at the Fire House, Fire Station 9 at 450 Estudillo Avenue, on Sunday, December 13, from 1 to 4 pm.
Are San Leandro's holiday events free?
Yes. The City of San Leandro calendar lists the tree lighting, Santa at the Fire House, Holiday Cookies with the Cops and the library's holiday programs as free. Some events ask for toy donations.
How do I get to San Leandro by BART?
San Leandro has two BART stations, San Leandro and Bay Fair. Bay Fair station is at 15242 Hesperian Boulevard and serves Bayfair Center.
